mechanism: Both agents cause carbonic anhydrase inhibition and electrolyte depletion (hypokalemia, hyponatremia), and dorzolamide may reduce renal clearance of bumetanide, potentiating diuretic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, sodium, bicarbonate) and renal function regularly; consider potassium supplementation and assess for symptoms of hypokalemia or metabolic acidosis.
